texts.li: {B_nameDef} cooked something special, set it on the table for one minute, and came back to find {PET_nameDef} licking the plate clean. {PET_nameDef} belongs to {A_nameDef}.\n\n{B_nameDef} wants something done about that animal. {A_nameDef} wants everyone to calm down.

{PET_nameDef} got into {B_nameDef}'s food again, the third time this season. {B_nameDef} has come to the council with what's left of the bowl.\n\n{A_nameDef} says {PET_nameDef} is just hungry. {B_nameDef} says so is everyone.

li.label: {A_nameDef} cooks {B_nameDef} a new meal
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} cooked {B_nameDef} a replacement dinner, badly. {PET_nameDef} watched the whole time.

li.label: It's an animal. Let it go
li.outcome: The council shrugged. {B_nameDef} has started eating with one arm around the bowl.

li.label: Turn {PET_nameDef} loose in the wild
li.outcome: {PET_nameDef} was walked to the edge of the map and left there. {A_nameDef} hasn't said a word to anyone since.

texts.li: {B_nameDef} found {PET_nameDef}'s hair in the stew again, and {PET_nameDef} asleep in the flour. {B_nameDef} is threatening to stop cooking until something changes.\n\n{PET_nameDef} is {A_nameDef}'s, and {A_nameDef} thinks {B_nameDef} is overreacting.
"Either that animal leaves my kitchen or I do," {B_nameDef} told the council, pointing at {PET_nameDef}. {A_nameDef} pointed out that {PET_nameDef} was there first. This did not help.

li.label: Keep {PET_nameDef} out of the kitchen
li.outcome: {PET_nameDef} is banned from the kitchen and spends meals staring through the door, wounded. {A_nameDef} grumbles.

li.label: The kitchen is {PET_nameDef}'s too
li.outcome: {PET_nameDef} stays. So does the hair in the stew. {B_nameDef} cooks with a grim face now.

li.label: Let them sort it out between them
li.outcome: The council stayed out of it. {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} are now in a cold war, with {PET_nameDef} as the disputed territory.
li.riskOutcome: The council stayed out of it, and {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} came to blows over {PET_nameDef}, who watched from under the table.
